description:
Tower Lead (Support \& Operations)
Gautam Buddha Nagar, Uttar Pradesh
**Job Summary**
---------------


**Senior Forward Deployment Engineer – AWS Agentic AI**


Job Type

  

Full\-Time

  

  

Experience

  

8–12 years overall; at least 3 years in Generative AI / Agentic AI with significant enterprise production delivery on AWS

  

  

Locations

  

Noida, Hyderabad, Chennai, Bangalore, Pune

  

  

Primary Focus

  

Solution architecture, customer technical leadership, production strategy, technical governance and FDE leadership


  

**Role Overview**
=================


We are looking for a Senior Forward Deployment Engineer (FDE) to lead the technical architecture and end\-to\-end deployment of enterprise Generative AI and Agentic AI solutions for strategic customers on AWS. The Senior FDE is a customer\-facing solution architect who can code: they own the technical success of the customer engagement, make architecture and deployment decisions, lead customer workshops, review implementation, drive production readiness, and mentor FDEs.


* Customer\-facing solution architect who can code
* Owns technical success of the customer engagement
* Makes architecture and production decisions
* Leads FDEs and influences the platform roadmap
  

Typical time allocation


* \~50% architecture and technical leadership
* \~30% customer leadership
* \~20% engineering oversight and mentoring
**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------


* Own the overall technical delivery of enterprise Agentic AI deployments from discovery and architecture through production rollout, hypercare, and transition to BAU.
* Lead customer discovery, technical workshops, architecture reviews, executive technical discussions, solution demonstrations, POCs, pilots, and production planning.
* Design customer\-specific AI and AWS architectures using Amazon Bedrock, Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, AWS services, enterprise data sources, applications, security controls, and operational services.
* Define agent architecture including multi\-agent patterns, Planner/Critic/Supervisor/Orchestrator designs, domain agents, Skills, tools, RAG, human\-in\-the\-loop controls, state, and enterprise integrations.
* Define the integration architecture for REST APIs, MCP tools, databases, ITSM platforms, monitoring systems, identity systems, messaging systems, and proprietary applications.
* Decide which requirements should be implemented through configuration, customer\-specific extensions, or reusable platform capabilities; drive the appropriate engineering path.
* Define production deployment architecture across Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Runtime, Gateway, Memory, Identity, Policy and Evaluations, Lambda, ECS, EKS, API Gateway, EventBridge, Step Functions, S3, CloudWatch, IAM, networking, and other appropriate AWS services.
* Define production architecture requirements for availability, scalability, security, resiliency, observability, release management, rollback, disaster recovery, and operational support.
* Lead security and identity architecture discussions covering IAM, role\-based access, authentication, authorization, Secrets Manager, data protection, auditability, VPC controls, and network security.
* Define and review production readiness criteria covering functionality, security, performance, reliability, evaluation, observability, governance, supportability, and operational readiness.
* Define the customer AgentOps strategy including telemetry, tracing, logging, metrics, evaluation, quality monitoring, cost monitoring, and operational dashboards.
* Lead complex troubleshooting and root\-cause analysis for production issues involving agents, models, RAG, tools, integrations, networking, authentication, and AWS infrastructure.
* Drive reliability, latency, scalability, model performance, and AI cost optimization across customer deployments.
* Define and review CI/CD, release management, environment promotion, versioning, rollback, and deployment processes.
* Review architecture, integration code, deployment plans, and technical deliverables produced by FDEs; establish engineering quality standards.
* Mentor and technically guide FDEs and Associate FDEs working on customer deployments.
* Establish reusable deployment patterns, integration patterns, reference architectures, runbooks, onboarding standards, and troubleshooting playbooks.
* Identify recurring customer requirements and drive their conversion into reusable agents, Skills, tools, connectors, frameworks, and platform capabilities with Agent Development / Platform Engineering teams.
* Act as the senior technical escalation point for complex customer issues and major production incidents.
* Provide technical feedback to Product, Agent Development, Platform Engineering, Security, Cloud Architecture, and Operations teams and influence platform roadmap priorities.
* Lead technical handover, customer enablement, operational readiness, and transition to support/BAU teams.
**Skill Requirements**
----------------------


**Must Have Skills**
====================


* Strong Python and software engineering skills with the ability to review and guide production code.
* Extensive hands\-on experience with Generative AI, LLMs, RAG, prompt engineering, tool calling, evaluation, and multi\-agent architectures.
* Strong hands\-on experience with Amazon Bedrock and/or Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, with LangGraph/LangChain/Strands Agents or equivalent frameworks in production.
* Strong AWS architecture and engineering experience across Amazon Bedrock and core AWS services.
* Strong enterprise integration experience across REST APIs, databases, ITSM platforms, monitoring systems, identity platforms, and customer\-specific applications.
* Strong understanding of AWS IAM, role\-based access, OAuth, secrets management, authentication, authorization, security, and enterprise networking.
* Strong experience with containerized applications, Docker, ECS/EKS, Lambda, AgentCore Runtime, and production deployment patterns.
* Strong experience with CI/CD, Git, release management, versioning, and production operations.
* Strong experience with observability, tracing, logging, monitoring, debugging, evaluation, and production incident management.
* Strong understanding of RAG architecture, knowledge integration, retrieval, evaluation, and agent quality measurement.
* Experience with Responsible AI, guardrails, AI security, data protection, and enterprise governance.
* Strong customer\-facing communication skills and ability to lead architecture conversations with senior technical stakeholders.

**Preferred Skills**
====================


* Deep experience with Amazon Bedrock, AgentCore Runtime, Gateway, Memory, Identity, Policy, Evaluations, and AgentCore Observability.
* Experience with OpenTelemetry/ADOT, enterprise AgentOps, and agent evaluation practices.
* Experience with MCP, A2A, AWS SDKs, and enterprise agent interoperability.
* Experience with Terraform / Infrastructure\-as\-Code and enterprise AWS landing zones.
* Strong experience with Lambda, ECS, EKS, API Gateway, EventBridge, Step Functions, SQS/SNS, S3, Secrets Manager, CloudWatch, networking, VPC endpoints, and private connectivity.
* Experience with ServiceNow, ITSM, CloudOps, SRE, AIOps, infrastructure automation, or enterprise operations.
* Experience designing highly available, scalable, secure production architectures.
* Experience leading POCs, pilots, MVPs, production rollouts, and strategic enterprise deployments.
* Exposure to multiple cloud platforms is advantageous.
**Other Requirements**
----------------------


**Qualifications**
==================


* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or related field.
* 8–12 years of overall software engineering, cloud engineering, solution architecture, or equivalent technical experience.
* At least 3 years of practical Generative AI / Agentic AI experience.
* Demonstrated track record of delivering multiple enterprise technology or AI solutions into production.
* Demonstrated customer\-facing technical leadership and architecture ownership.

**Key Attributes**
==================


* Strong customer\-facing presence and ability to build technical trust with enterprise customers.
* Strong ownership of outcomes rather than individual tasks.
* Excellent architecture and problem\-solving skills.
* Comfortable operating across AI engineering, AWS cloud architecture, integration, security, and operations.
* Able to make pragmatic decisions between reusable platform capabilities and customer\-specific implementation.
* Strong mentoring and technical leadership capability.

title: Senior Network Engineer
description:
**Senior Network Engineer** **–** **Wireless** **\&** **Network**
**Team Lead**
===============================================================================


**Ready to combine hands\-on network engineering with practical team leadership?** We are looking for an experienced Senior Network Engineer who can guide colleagues, coordinate delivery and still enjoy getting close to the technology.


ASSA ABLOY Global IT manages shared infrastructure, global applications and security for globally delivered solutions. We operate in a multi\-sourcing environment and work closely with internal customers, strategic partners, suppliers and colleagues across the world.


In this role, you will join the Global IT Network Services organisation, part of the Infrastructure team. Your main focus will be wireless and LAN services, while your wider network perspective will help the team deliver stable, secure and future\-ready services.


**About the role**
------------------


You will be a senior technical contributor and a natural team lead for the WiFi and LAN area. You will help the team plan and prioritise work, coordinate technical activities, and ensure consistent and well\-aligned delivery.


This is a role where leadership is combined with means stepping away from engineering. You will work hands\-on with architecture, design, implementation, troubleshooting and documentation, while coaching colleagues and creating a collaborative, accountable way of working.


You will also act as an important link between engineers, customers, service management and external providers. By turning requirements and operational feedback into practical improvements, you will help develop global network services that provide real business value.


The wider team supports infrastructure services across WiFi, LAN, WAN, Remote Access, DDI, firewalls, load balancing, web security and monitoring, providing opportunities to collaborate broadly between teams.


**To summarise:** You will lead through expertise, teamwork and a strong commitment to hands\-on contribution.

  

**What you will do**
--------------------


* Provide day\-to\-day technical leadership for the team, including planning, prioritisation and coordination of work.
* Coach and support engineers, encourage knowledge sharing and help the team grow its technical capability.
* Acting as a contact for network infrastructure within all the global regions.
* Work closely with customers and colleagues worldwide on service enquiries, incidents, changes and improvements.
* Collect requirements and feedback from customers and stakeholders, then translate them into practical solutions.
* Contribute to common network architecture, design standards, roadmaps and service catalogue development.
* Review service performance, metrics and SLAs, and be able to lead improvement activities when needed.
* Present technical findings and recommendations clearly to both technical and non\-technical audiences.
* Keep processes, operational routines and documentation clear, current and useful.
* Involved and influence in 24/7 operation optimization vs delivery.

**What you bring**
------------------


We are looking for someone with strong technical skills who is confident taking the lead and works well with others. You can organise work in a clear and practical way without adding unnecessary processes. You also understand how to meet today’s operational needs while continuing to improve services for the future.


* Proven experience as a team lead, technical lead or senior engineer who has coordinated and guided others.
* At least ten years of experience in network infrastructure, including significant hands\-on work in projects or complex enterprise environments.
* Very strong knowledge of LAN, WiFi, routing and switching.
* Hands\-on experience with Cisco wireless technologies, including WLC, Catalyst Center and Cisco ISE.
* Experience working with global service providers, partners and distributed teams.
* A good understanding of service management, SLAs, operational processes and continuous improvement.
* Strong skills in technical design, documentation, troubleshooting and stakeholder communication.
* A customer\-focused, structured and proactive approach.
* Fluent written and spoken English.

**Nice to have**
----------------


* Experience with agile ways of working.
* Background in customer\-facing engineering, consulting, professional services, presales, post\-sales or product development.
* Experience contributing to service roadmaps, service catalogues and vendor evaluations.
* Relevant Cisco certifications or equivalent practical expertise.

**What we offer**
-----------------


* A visible role in a global network organisation with the opportunity to influence services used across global regions.
* A combination of technical depth, team leadership and service development.
* Close collaboration with experienced colleagues, customers and strategic technology partners.
* A working environment where practical ideas, clear communication and a positive team spirit matter.

**Location**
------------


* Chennai, India.
* The role is based at the ASSA ABLOY office.

**Interested?** If you enjoy leading people through expertise, improving global services and solving real network challenges, we would be happy to hear from you.

  



**We are the ASSA ABLOY Group**
  

Our people have made us the global leader in access solutions. In return, we open doors for them wherever they go. With nearly 63,000 colleagues in more than 70 different countries, we help billions of people experience a more open world. Our innovations make all sorts of spaces – physical and virtual – safer, more secure, and easier to access.


As an employer, we value results – not titles, or backgrounds. We empower our people to build their career around their aspirations and our ambitions – supporting them with regular feedback, training, and development opportunities. Our colleagues think broadly about where they can make the most impact, and we encourage them to grow their role locally, regionally, or even internationally.


As we welcome new people on board, it’s important to us to have diverse, inclusive teams, and we value different perspectives and experiences.

**Overview**
------------


### **About us**


We are the independent expert in assurance and risk management. Driven by our purpose, to safeguard life, property, and the environment, we empower our customers and their stakeholders with facts and reliable insights so that critical decisions can be made with confidence.


As a trusted voice for many of the world’s most successful organizations, we use our knowledge to advance safety and performance, set industry benchmarks, and inspire and invent solutions to tackle global transformations.


**About Energy Systems**  

  

We help customers navigate the complex transition to a decarbonized and more sustainable energy future. We do this by assuring that energy systems work safely and effectively, using solutions that are increasingly digital. We also help industries and governments to navigate the many complex, interrelated transitions taking place globally and regionally, in the energy industry.
### **About the role**


The Senior Software Engineer is responsible for designing, developing, testing, deploying, and supporting production\-grade software products and shared platform capabilities within DNV’s Digital \& Transformation organization. This role sits within the Application Engineering section and contributes to the development and modernization of scalable web applications that support digital delivery across Energy Systems.


This role helps to advance how DNV performs Due Diligence, Verification \& Assurance, and Renewables Certification work across Energy Systems.  

  



This is not a project\-based delivery or staff\-augmentation role. Engineers are expected to develop deep product knowledge and remain accountable for the quality, maintainability, and operation of the software they build.
  

Working in close partnership with Frontend Engineers, Product leadership, Data \& AI Engineering, Solution Engineering, Platform Reliability, Solution Architecture, and Platform Security \& Compliance, this role helps bring application capabilities, data services, AI\-enabled features, workflows, and APIs into one cohesive platform and product experience.
  

The Senior Software Engineer designs, builds, tests, deploys, and supports scalable software across a modern Microsoft\-oriented full\-stack environment. The primary stack includes C\# and .NET 10, Entity Framework Core, SignalR, MySQL, Redis, TypeScript, React, Redux, Tailwind CSS, Docker, .NET Aspire, Azure Functions, Azure Storage, Azure AI Search, and Azure DevOps. The role requires strong engineering fundamentals, practical cloud experience, and the ability to collaborate effectively across globally distributed teams.  

  



This role supports custom software development, application modernization, and integration with low\-code or hybrid development environments, helping establish shared patterns, APIs, reusable components, and maintainable application architecture across the platform.  

  



\*\*This role is based at our DNV office in Chennai, India. Further details regarding role\-specific requirements will be shared during the interview process.\*\*


**Key Responsibilities**


**Software Engineering \& Delivery**


* Design, develop, test, and maintain scalable application and platform capabilities using modern software engineering practices.
* Build cohesive product experiences across backend services, APIs and platform integrations.
* Work directly with Product and Architecture stakeholders to shape requirements, evaluate technical approaches, and translate product direction into maintainable, production\-ready software.
* Participate actively in code reviews, technical design discussions, estimation, delivery planning, and implementation decisions.
* Write clean, well\-structured, testable, and maintainable code that supports long\-term product quality and team velocity.
* Own product capabilities through design, implementation, deployment, monitoring, maintenance, and iterative improvement rather than treating delivery as complete when the initial feature is released.

**.NET Application Development**


* Develop modern API capabilities using C\#, .NET 10, Entity Framework Core, SignalR, and related technologies.
* Develop solutions for Azure and contribute to their deployment and support.
* Support application modernization efforts, including refactoring, technical debt reduction, framework upgrades, and migration from legacy patterns where appropriate.
* Develop application capabilities used for structured review workflows, real\-time collaboration, issue tracking, customer interaction, reporting, and delivery of technical work products.
* Partner with Product and design stakeholders to ensure application functionality is intuitive, reliable, and aligned with user workflows.
* Develop APIs, backend services, frontend components, and integration patterns that support platform interoperability.
* Help integrate applications with data services, AI\-enabled capabilities, workflow configurations, authentication patterns, and enterprise systems.
* Contribute to reusable development patterns, documentation, and engineering practices that improve team velocity and consistency.
* Integrate data\-driven, search, agentic, and AI\-enabled capabilities into production web applications using well\-defined APIs and reusable application patterns.

**Modern Development \& AI\-Enabled Engineering**


* Use AI\-assisted development tools to accelerate coding, testing, debugging, documentation, refactoring, and engineering analysis.
* Apply strong engineering judgment when using LLM\-enabled workflows, ensuring generated or assisted code meets standards for quality, security, maintainability, and performance.
* Use AI\-enabled tools where appropriate to support test generation, code review preparation, technical documentation, and developer productivity.

**DevOps, Reliability \& Security**


* Contribute to Azure DevOps repositories and pipelines, automated testing, deployment automation, environment management, monitoring, and incident readiness.
* Build software using an Agile methodology, with strong attention to reliability, performance, availability, scalability, and operational support.
* Support observability practices including logging, monitoring, error handling, and production diagnostics.
* Follow secure development practices aligned with internal security standards, SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, and enterprise security expectations.
* Collaborate with Platform Reliability, Security, and Global Shared Services teams to support secure, reliable, and maintainable production systems.

**Collaboration \& Technical Ownership**


* Work effectively with Product, Solution Engineering, Data \& AI Engineering, Platform Reliability, Architecture, Security, and regional teams in a globally distributed environment.
* Take ownership of assigned features, services, defects, and technical improvements from design through production support.
* Communicate technical trade\-offs clearly and contribute to pragmatic engineering decisions.
* Mentor less experienced engineers through code reviews, technical guidance, pairing, and shared engineering practices.
* Contribute to a culture of accountability, collaboration, continuous improvement, and delivery excellence.
* Contribute actively within planning and design meetings, speaking up where potential issues arise or where a requirement is poorly defined.
* Champion potential solutions to problems and communicate them clearly to the team.
### **What we offer**


* Flexible work arrangements for better work\-life balance
* Generous Paid Leaves (Annual, Sick, Compassionate, Local Public, Marriage, Maternity, Paternity, Medical leave)
* Medical benefits ( Insurance and Annual Health Check\-up)
* Pension and Insurance Policies (Group Term Life Insurance, Group Personal Accident Insurance, Travel Insurance)
* Training and Development Assistance (Training Sponsorship, On\-The\-Job Training, Training Programme)

The Technical Project Manager owns the safe, predictable and high\-quality execution of project and live network intervention (LNI) activity within an assigned practice. The role combines genuine technical depth with delivery rigour — every activity executed safely, on time and with zero customer impact.
  

This is a hands\-on role. The TPM is expected to hold the technical command to review a MoP, challenge an implementation approach and lead a critical incident personally — while driving standardisation, automation and a strong engineering culture within the team. The TPM reports to the practice Delivery Manager and is the primary execution owner beneath that layer.
**Key Responsibilities**
========================


**1\. End\-to\-End Delivery Ownership**
---------------------------------------


* Own complete execution of assigned work packages from planning through successful completion.
* Ensure every intervention is delivered safely, within schedule and in compliance with customer standards.
* Drive timely closure of all deliverables while proactively managing risks and dependencies.
* Take accountability for delivery outcomes rather than simply tracking activities.
* Provide the Delivery Manager with accurate, early and unfiltered status — no surprises.

**2\. Work Package Planning \& Ownership**
------------------------------------------


* Allocate work packages to engineers based on competency, certifications and experience.
* Ensure the right engineer is assigned to the right task, with verified readiness.
* Monitor work package progress, remove execution blockers and maintain delivery governance.
* Ensure ownership across the entire lifecycle of each assigned activity.

**3\. Customer Project Alignment**
----------------------------------


* Work closely with customer project managers, planners and technical leads.
* Ensure LNI execution aligns with project timelines, milestones and deployment priorities.
* Represent the execution team during customer governance meetings.
* Build customer confidence through proactive communication and predictable delivery.

**4\. Technical Leadership — Hands On**
---------------------------------------


* Maintain genuine working command of the practice domain — not oversight from a distance.
* Provide technical guidance during planning, execution, rollback and issue resolution.
* Review implementation approaches, Method of Procedure (MoP), rollback plans and risk assessments; approve before execution.
* Lead technical discussions during complex interventions and critical incidents, and drive root cause analysis personally.
* Coach engineers on best practices and promote continuous technical improvement.

**5\. Standardisation**
-----------------------


* Execute against the practice delivery framework — MoP templates, checklists, readiness criteria and acceptance standards — and drive full team adoption.
* Eliminate ad\-hoc, engineer\-specific ways of working; make execution repeatable regardless of who performs it.
* Convert every lesson learned into an updated standard, checklist or preventive control.
* Feed practice\-level gaps and improvement proposals back to the Delivery Manager for framework updates.

The Industrial Automation and PLC Programming Lead will serve as a technical subject\-matter expert for shop\-floor automation and controls systems supporting manufacturing operations and forward model programs.

The role will manage and prioritize automation\-related support requests, troubleshoot production\-impacting issues, perform root\-cause analysis, and serve as an escalation point for complex or recurring controls problems.
The position will also lead the development, documentation, and implementation of programming standards, reusable software libraries, naming conventions, controls templates, and engineering best practices. **Production and Technical Support**
* Manage and prioritize technical support requests involving PLCs, HMIs, MES interfaces, robotics, and industrial connectivity systems.
* Provide advanced troubleshooting and programming support for production\-impacting controls and automation issues.
* Diagnose PLC logic, HMI application, communication, robotics, and shop\-floor system failures.

* Act as an escalation point for complex, recurring, or high\-impact technical issues.
* Coordinate with manufacturing, maintenance, controls engineering, information technology, operational technology, and supplier teams during issue resolution.

* Establish consistent naming conventions, program structures, alarm strategies, diagnostic methods, and documentation requirements.
* Develop reusable logic modules, Add\-On Instructions, function blocks, HMI objects, templates, and software libraries.
* Lead the migration or alignment of legacy controls programs with approved standards and reusable architectures.
* Conduct technical design reviews and periodic audits to assess compliance with established controls standards.
* Identify opportunities to reduce engineering effort, improve maintainability, and increase consistency across equipment and manufacturing lines.
* Establish appropriate software backup, change\-management, release\-management, and version\-control practices for PLC, HMI, and robot programs.
* Maintain standard technical documents, implementation guidelines, checklists, and validation procedures.
* Support the structured rollout and adoption of new controls standards across relevant plants, programs, or production lines.

* Review and optimize PLC program architecture, sequencing, interlocks, alarms, fault handling, and equipment diagnostics.
* Support commissioning, production launch, equipment integration, and continuous\-improvement activities.
* Ensure that controls programs are appropriately documented, tested, backed up, and maintained.
* Support the implementation of effective equipment recovery, troubleshooting, and diagnostic features.

description:
We are seeking an experienced Manager \- Reliability \& Root Cause Analysis to lead a multidisciplinary engineering team within the Fleet Intelligence \& Reliability organization. The team is responsible for identifying systemic fleet risks, determining the physical and systemic causes of complex failures, and ensuring that corrective and preventive actions deliver measurable and sustainable reliability improvement across the global Solar and Storage installed fleet.
  

This role owns the technical governance of Root Cause Analyses for complex, high\-impact, recurring, and fleet\-wide issues. The manager will ensure that investigations are evidence\-based, technically rigorous, and completed with clear accountability from initial containment through corrective\-action validation and fleet\-risk closure.
  

The leader will manage engineers across relevant disciplines, which may include power electronics, electrical systems, mechanical systems, embedded software, plant controls, and systems engineering. The position requires close partnership with Fleet Performance \& Analytics, Product Engineering, Quality, Manufacturing, Sourcing, Project Engineering, Field Operations, and commercial teams to convert fleet experience into product and operational improvement.
**Job Description**
===================


**Roles and Responsibilities**
==============================


* Lead, coach, and develop a multidisciplinary engineering team responsible for fleet reliability, failure investigation, and Root Cause Analysis.
* Own and continuously improve the RCA governance process, including issue prioritization, ownership assignment, technical reviews, milestones, escalation, corrective\-action tracking, validation, and closure criteria.
* Lead investigations of complex, high\-impact, systemic, and recurring failures affecting solar inverters, battery energy storage systems, plant controls, power conversion equipment, and associated interfaces.
* Ensure investigations are grounded in verified evidence, operating data, event logs, inspection results, failure reproduction, laboratory analysis, engineering calculations, and appropriate structured problem\-solving methods.
* Differentiate failure symptoms, direct physical causes, contributing factors, systemic causes, and organizational causes, ensuring that conclusions are supported by evidence.
* Drive immediate containment, short\-term mitigation, and permanent corrective and preventive actions with the relevant engineering and operational owners.
* Prioritize investigations using safety exposure, customer impact, availability loss, recurrence, fleet population, warranty exposure, and financial consequence.
* Maintain a fleet\-level view of failure modes and systemic risk across products, projects, regions, configurations, software versions, suppliers, and operating environments.
* Partner with Fleet Performance \& Analytics to use fleet data, trends, event signatures, and risk models to detect emerging issues, quantify exposure, and verify corrective\-action effectiveness.
* Translate field and fleet learning into recommendations for product requirements, design changes, validation plans, software releases, manufacturing processes, supplier controls, maintenance strategies, and technical documentation.
* Provide technical leadership during critical fleet events, customer escalations, and executive\-level issue reviews.
* Ensure customer\-facing and internal RCA reports are accurate, evidence\-based, clear, and delivered in accordance with committed milestones.
* Develop and maintain reusable engineering knowledge, including RCA standards, failure libraries, lessons learned, troubleshooting guides, technical advisories, and investigation templates.
* Support the definition and deployment of Change, Modification, and Upgrade actions resulting from fleet reliability findings.
* Establish and monitor meaningful metrics such as RCA cycle time, milestone adherence, recurrence rate, corrective\-action closure, investigation backlog, and quantified fleet\-risk reduction.
* Promote a culture of safety, technical rigor, accountability, collaboration, transparency, and continuous improvement.

**Required Qualifications**
===========================


* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Systems Engineering, Control Systems Engineering, Power Electronics, or a related technical field.
* Demonstratable experience in engineering, reliability, failure analysis, product engineering, installed\-base engineering, or a related technical function.
* Demonstrated experience leading complex technical investigations or RCAs involving multidisciplinary systems.
* Demonstrated experience leading engineers, technical teams, or significant cross\-functional engineering programs.
* Experience with power generation, renewable energy, battery energy storage, power conversion, industrial automation, or comparable complex industrial equipment.
* Ability and willingness to travel internationally as required.

**Desired Characteristics**
===========================


* Advanced degree in engineering, reliability, systems engineering, or a related discipline.
* Previous people\-leadership experience within a global engineering or technical organization.
* Strong knowledge of solar inverters, battery energy storage systems, power electronics, plant controls, electrical protection, thermal management, and industrial communication networks.
* Experience applying structured investigation methodologies such as Fault Tree Analysis, 5 Whys, Ishikawa analysis, 8D, Kepner\-Tregoe, or Failure Mode and Effects Analysis.
* Knowledge of reliability engineering, failure mechanisms, accelerated testing, design validation, reliability growth, and corrective\-action effectiveness assessment.
* Experience analyzing operational data, waveforms, alarms, event logs, failed components, inspection evidence, and intervention history.
* Strong systems thinking, technical judgment, and ability to make risk\-based decisions with incomplete or evolving information.
* Proven ability to influence Product Engineering, Quality, Manufacturing, Sourcing, Operations, and commercial teams in a matrixed environment.
* Strong customer\-facing skills and the ability to communicate sensitive technical findings with clarity, credibility, and appropriate transparency.
* Ability to manage multiple high\-priority investigations across a global fleet.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Self\-starting attitude with the ability to establish structure, set priorities, develop people, and drive issues through sustainable closure.

**Job Description**

We are looking for a **Senior Engineer – Controls** with 8\+ years of experience in the design, development, modification, migration, integration, and implementation of **PLC and HMI/SCADA systems for discrete machinery and equipment** .


The ideal candidate will have strong hands\-on experience with a combination of **Siemens, Allen\-Bradley (Rockwell Automation), and Beckhoff** automation platforms. Experience in **printing, paper converting, packaging, textile, or other machinery/OEM industries** is highly preferred.


The engineer should be able to take a systems approach to understand the overall machine design, mechanical functions, electrical architecture, control philosophy, safety systems, and automation requirements, and develop robust PLC and HMI programs ensuring the overall functional quality and performance of the machinery/equipment.


The role will be responsible for the interface between **electrical hardware, PLC software, HMI/SCADA, drives, motion systems, instrumentation, and machine\-level automation** .


**Technical Skills**
--------------------

### **PLC \& HMI Platforms**

Strong hands\-on experience in one or more of the following platforms, with the ability to work across multiple automation platforms:


* **Siemens S7\-1200 / S7\-1500 PLCs**
* **Siemens Comfort Panels / Unified Comfort Panels**
* **Allen\-Bradley / Rockwell Automation PLCs**
	+ ControlLogix
	+ CompactLogix
* **Beckhoff PLC / IPC\-based control systems**
	+ TwinCAT 3
	+ EtherCAT
* Experience with HMI/SCADA development and integration across Siemens, Allen\-Bradley, and Beckhoff platforms.

### **PLC \& HMI Development**

* Hands\-on experience developing **PLC and HMI programs from scratch** based on URS, functional specifications, and client standards.
* Ability to understand and develop PLC programs using:
	+ Ladder Logic
	+ Function Block Diagram
	+ Structured Text
	+ Sequential Function Chart
* Develop machine sequences, interlocks, alarms, permissives, recipes, diagnostics, and operator interfaces.
* Interface PLC programs with HMI/SCADA systems.
* Experience in modifying, debugging, migrating, and optimizing existing PLC/HMI programs.
* Experience with **machine\-level automation and discrete manufacturing applications** .
* HMI scripting/programming experience using **JavaScript, C\#, or similar technologies** is an added advantage.

**Siemens Automation**
----------------------

* Strong hands\-on experience with **Siemens S7\-1500 PLCs** .
* Experience with **TIA Portal V15\.1 or above** .
* TIA Portal V17/V18/V19 or later experience preferred.
* Siemens Comfort and Unified Comfort HMI development.
* PLC/HMI programming, troubleshooting, commissioning, and debugging.
* Experience with Siemens drives and motion systems is preferred.

**Allen\-Bradley / Rockwell Automation**
----------------------------------------

* Hands\-on experience with **Allen\-Bradley PLCs** .
* Experience with **ControlLogix and/or CompactLogix** platforms.
* Rockwell Studio 5000 / RSLogix programming experience.
* Allen\-Bradley HMI experience using **FactoryTalk View** is preferred.
* Experience with Rockwell drives, I/O, communication networks, and motion systems is an advantage.

**Beckhoff Automation**
-----------------------

* Hands\-on experience with **Beckhoff PLC/control systems** .
* Experience with **TwinCAT 3** programming and development.
* Knowledge of **EtherCAT** communication and distributed I/O systems.
* Experience with Beckhoff IPCs, motion control, servo systems, and drives is preferred.
* Experience developing machine control applications using Structured Text is an advantage.

**Industrial Communication \& Networking**
------------------------------------------

Good understanding of industrial communication protocols and networking, including:


* PROFINET / PROFIBUS
* EtherNet/IP
* EtherCAT
* AS\-i
* CAN / CANopen
* DeviceNet
* Modbus TCP/RTU
* OPC UA
* Other industrial Ethernet and fieldbus protocols

Ability to configure, troubleshoot, and integrate PLCs, remote I/O, drives, HMIs, sensors, and other automation devices over industrial networks.


**Drives, Motors \& Motion Control**
------------------------------------

* Knowledge of selection and application of motors, motor controllers, VFDs, servo drives, and motion\-control systems.
* Understanding of:
	+ Motor horsepower
	+ Torque
	+ Speed range
	+ Gear ratios
	+ Reduction ratios
	+ Acceleration/deceleration
* Experience with Siemens, Allen\-Bradley, or Beckhoff drives is preferred.
* Basic understanding of servo positioning and motion\-control applications.

**Instrumentation \& Control Components**
-----------------------------------------

Good understanding of selection and application of industrial control components, including:


* Sensors for flow, pressure, level, temperature, position, speed, counters, motion, vision, etc.
* Digital and analog sensors
* Proximity and photoelectric sensors
* Encoders
* Transducers
* Solenoid valves
* Relays
* Contactors
* On/Off control devices
* Analog I/O and signal conditioning
* A/D and D/A conversion
* I/P and P/I conversion

Understanding of sensor characteristics such as accuracy, precision, response time, repeatability, reliability, range, and environmental/temperature effects.


**FAT, SAT \& Commissioning**
-----------------------------

* Develop automation test cases and procedures for **Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT)** and **Site Acceptance Testing (SAT)** .
* Participate in FAT/SAT with customers and project teams.
* Hands\-on experience in machine installation, commissioning, troubleshooting, and start\-up.
* Ability to troubleshoot PLC, HMI, drives, I/O, communication, and machine sequence issues.
* Experience with remote commissioning and troubleshooting tools.
* Willingness to travel to customer sites for commissioning and project support.

**Standards \& Compliance**
---------------------------

Working knowledge of applicable industry codes, standards, and regulations such as:


* ANSI
* ISA
* NEC
* NEMA
* NFPA
* OSHA
* UL

Experience working with machine safety systems and safety PLCs is an added advantage.


**Tool Skills**
===============

### **Mandatory / Core**

* **Siemens TIA Portal – V15\.1 or above**
* Siemens S7\-1500 PLC
* Siemens Comfort / Unified Comfort HMI
* **Allen\-Bradley / Rockwell Studio 5000**
* ControlLogix / CompactLogix
* **Beckhoff TwinCAT 3**
* EtherCAT

### **Preferred**

* TIA Portal V17\+
* FactoryTalk View
* Siemens / Rockwell / Beckhoff drives and motion systems
* OPC UA
* Industrial Ethernet networking
* HMI scripting / C\# / JavaScript
* EPLAN or similar electrical engineering tools

**Education \& Experience**
===========================

* Bachelor's degree in **Electrical \& Electronics Engineering (EEE), Electronics \& Communication Engineering (ECE), Instrumentation, or related engineering discipline** .
* **8\+ years of experience in industrial automation and controls engineering.**
* Strong hands\-on experience in PLC and HMI programming.
* Experience with **a combination of Siemens, Allen\-Bradley, and Beckhoff platforms** is strongly preferred.
* Demonstrated experience developing PLC/HMI programs **from scratch** .
* Experience in machinery/OEM applications is highly preferred.
* Experience in **printing, packaging, paper converting, textile, or other discrete machinery industries** is an advantage.
* Experience in machine commissioning and customer\-site support is preferred.

**Key Result Areas**
====================

* Configure automation hardware and software according to project design specifications.
* Develop PLC and HMI programs from scratch based on machine automation requirements.
* Integrate Siemens, Allen\-Bradley, and Beckhoff automation platforms with machine hardware and control systems.
* Ensure optimal performance, reliability, quality, and responsiveness of PLC/HMI applications.
* Troubleshoot PLC, HMI, drives, motion, I/O, and industrial communication issues.
* Follow software development, change\-management, and version\-control procedures.
* Maintain proper documentation of PLC/HMI software and project changes.
* Manage assigned projects and deliver according to agreed schedules and scope.
* Communicate project progress, technical issues, and risks to project stakeholders.
* Support FAT, SAT, machine start\-up, commissioning, and customer acceptance.
* Provide technical support to internal teams and customers as required.

**Soft Skills**
===============

* Strong verbal and written communication skills.
* Logical and systematic approach to problem\-solving.
* Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills.
* Ability to understand complex machine sequences and identify key technical issues.
* Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively within a multidisciplinary team.
* Strong customer\-facing and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and changing project requirements.
* Willingness to learn and work across multiple automation platforms.

**Travel**
==========

Occasional domestic and/or international travel may be required, up to **15%** , for customer meetings, FAT, SAT, installation, commissioning, troubleshooting, and project support.


**Preferred Candidate Profile**
-------------------------------

The ideal candidate will be a **multi\-platform Controls Engineer** with strong practical experience in:


**Siemens \+ Allen\-Bradley \+ Beckhoff**

with hands\-on capability in:


**PLC Programming HMI Development Drives/Motion Industrial Communication Machine Integration FAT/SAT Commissioning**

Experience with **OEM/discrete machinery** , particularly printing, packaging, paper converting, or textile machinery, will be a strong advantage.
